comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts robot gripper hardware; PR-2062 keeps a machine-loader nest stocked during variable autonomous cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coupled two-tool torque control; PR-2062 requires timed pick-place, precise nest seating, monitoring, and collision avoidance in shared workspace.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angle across test cycles; PR-2062 awards credit for five blanks successfully supplied and carried away by the loader.
comparison.reason: Both concern automation equipment, but they test configuration work versus reactive machine tending.
